notes: The word เท้า is used for the entire foot including the toes. It is the polite term; avoid confusing it with informal or derogatory terms when speaking to someone of higher status or in formal settings.
Be aware that in Thai culture, the feet are considered the lowest part of the body and are seen as dirty. Avoid pointing your feet at people or sacred objects.
